name: How do professionals remove smoke smell from walls?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals remove smoke smell from walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals remove smoke smell from walls through a multi-step process. First, they thoroughly clean all surfaces to remove soot and smoke residue, often using specialized industrial cleaners and HEPA vacuums. Next, they may apply odor-encapsulating primers or sealants to trap any remaining odor molecules within the wall material. Advanced techniques include using ozone generators, hydroxyl generators, or thermal fogging to neutralize microscopic smoke particles embedded in porous surfaces. Air scrubbers are also deployed to continuously filter the air and remove airborne contaminants. This comprehensive approach ensures deep deodorization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove smoke smell by cleaning soot, applying odor-encapsulating sealants, and using advanced equipment like ozone or hydroxyl generators to neutralize embedded particles.
